  Phase 5 patch (parent = upstream base):
    Patch branch      : macssh-vs16-preserve-base-width
    Patch revision    : 8a5187fe8182bac3a01f2b82d2621993de5886be
    Patch diff file   : Docs/swiftterm-vs16-patch.diff
    Purpose           : Opt-in VS16 preserve-base-width compatibility for the
                        local macOS shell. Adds TerminalOptions
                        variationSelector16WidthPolicy (.widenToEmojiWidth
                        default; .preserveBaseWidth for Local Terminal only).
                        Default SwiftTerm behavior is unchanged; the patch does
                        not strip VS16, does not rewrite PTY/CSI bytes, and does
                        not hardcode characters.
    Local Terminal    : variationSelector16WidthPolicy = .preserveBaseWidth
    Remote Terminal   : variationSelector16WidthPolicy = .widenToEmojiWidth
                        (SwiftTerm default; intentionally not enabled for remote
                        hosts whose wcwidth/locale may differ)

  Phase 6 patch (parent = Phase 5 patch; current production revision):
    Patch branch      : macssh-terminal-highlight-provider
    Patch revision    : 6e56e32e16eba0c3a5f534136da272679085f44c
    Patch diff file   : Docs/swiftterm-highlight-patch.diff
    Purpose           : Generic presentation-only cell background decoration hook.
                        Adds TerminalHighlightProvider protocol +
                        TerminalCellHighlight value type + weak
                        TerminalView.highlightProvider property (default nil =
                        no-op). buildAttributedString (shared by CoreGraphics
                        and Metal renderers) queries the provider once per
                        visible row and paints returned column ranges through
                        the existing SwiftTerm_selectionBackgroundColor attribute
                        channel, below selection and cursor, without touching
                        the foreground color, buffer, parser, or copied text.
                        TTColor typealias promoted to public (TTImage already
                        was). No MacSSH names / UserDefaults / Rule model in
                        SwiftTerm.
